transcript.text: and then you said maybe when I win the Intercontinental Championship,
I will feel something. How do you feel?
I feel weird, mostly because this is the ultimate goal.
And now that I've achieved it so early and so quickly, it's like skewed,
I guess my view of the future.
I don't know why I thought it would be so hard to obtain this.
And then it happened so fast that I feel like I should reassess my goals,
which happens to me a lot in my life.
And I think that's why I feel nothing.
